# Play — Which Way Up

- SudokuPad: [Which Way Up on SudokuPad](https://sudokupad.)
- f-puzzles: [Which Way Up on f-puzzles](https://www.f-puzzles.com/?)

Both links carry the same f-puzzles JSON (lz-string compressed) including the solution, so SudokuPad can check your answer.
Thermometers and XV are exported as native constraints, and the negative constraint is set with f-puzzles' `negative: ["xv"]` flag
(also stated in the rules text).
Fallback: `puzzle.json` in this folder is the machine-readable source (givens, constraints, solution).
